newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Chinese premier calls for more trade with Tanzania.
newsitem.headline: Chinese premier calls for more trade with Tanzania.

text.p: Chinese Prime Minister Li Peng called on Tueday for increased investment and trade with Tanzania in place of the old relationship of aid donor and recipient.
Li, on a seven-nation African tour, told a news conference in Dar es Salaam: "We want to develop entrepreneurial relations between us. Such cooperation is likely to benefit both of us."
"China is also ready to transfer technology to Tanzania for the exploitation of resources here," said Li, after signing an agreement for $15.5 million in Chinese aid for various projects.
It included $12.1 million for the Chinese-built Tanzanian -Zambia Railway Authority (TAZARA) line, which faces heavy competition from more reliable southern African carriers.
